shortDescription: Keep one project continuous across ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini without re-explaining everything.
description: MaglaSync Free helps ordinary AI users continue the same project across ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. It keeps a compact local project journal with goals, key decisions, constraints, results, blockers and next steps, then shows a reviewable handoff before the user places it into a fresh chat. The Free edition requires no MaglaSync account, AI API key, cloud backend or analytics, never sends automatically, and is open source under the MIT License.
pricingDetails: Free forever for one local project; no credit card or subscription required.
features: Cross-AI project continuity, local project journal, review-before-handoff, ChatGPT support, Claude support, Gemini support, no account, no AI API key, open source
